content.text: To n Kɛna yã́ dↄngu n ɛ̀waasogↄↄ
e gu àↄ gɛ́ dↄinɛ vãi,
e wɛ̃ pↄ́ ńyↄ̃ mɛ n pↄ nawào aↄ gɛ́ kái.
To aà yã́ dↄngu
e ĩatɛ̃ ń gupuao àↄ lao,
e mↄvua ń saanaↄ aaↄ siakũ,
e loumaa gbɛa gu weesai àↄ gɛ́ mↄ́i.
Gↄↄ bee n ↄↄ lualua,
n gbáↄ koo,
n pↄ́sobↄↄ kã́mabo kɛ́ aa dasi lↄo,
n gugwabↄↄ gu'e ń tↄ́ↄnau dã̀adãa.
N lɛ́ aↄ kpaaũa gãaɛ,
wísilↄgbɛ kↄ̃fĩ a busɛkũnɛ.
Bãↄ wii a n vu iu,
mɛ́ nɛnↄɛnaↄ lɛ a kɛnɛ busɛ.
Ńyↄ̃ vĩakɛ gulɛsĩɛ ń bɛa zɛ́ guuo,
n mikã a pu lán gyavuwa.
Ńyↄ̃ nzĩa gálɛ lán kwa táa'oawa,
pↄe a n mɛ fɛlɛ lↄo,
asa gbɛ̃nazĩna ì gɛ́ a gɛ́kĩiɛ,
ↄ̃ ↄↄlↄnaↄ ìↄ bɛ gãaɛ.
To n Kɛna yã́ dↄngu
e n ã́nusu ba àↄ gɛ́ kɛ̃́i,
e n vua ta àↄ gɛ́ kpàolokũi,
e n nibↄna lo àↄ gɛ́ wíwii,
e n lↄ̀ↄ wuluu àↄ gɛ́ ɛ́i,
e n bùsuti à ɛa àↄ gɛ́ gɛ̃i tɛ̃́ɛnau,
gu pↄ́ à bↄ̀u,
e n nisĩna àↄ gɛ́ tái
Lua pↄ́ kpàma kĩ́i.
Mapi ma Làasoode ma mɛ̀:
Yãpã búubuu, yã́pii pãɛ.

content: Bee gbɛa lá Làasoodepi ↄ̃nↄ, à dↄ̃a dàdanɛ́. À làasookɛ̀ à kpálɛkɛ̀ yã́ↄi, ↄ̃ à yáasiↄ kɛ̀kɛ dasi.
À kpálɛkɛ̀ yãmaai, ↄ̃ à yã́piↄ kɛ̃̀ a zɛ́wa, mɛ́ sĩanaɛ.

content.text: Ɔ̃nↄnaↄ yã́ↄ dɛ lán gése pↄ́ wì lɛ́ sↄ̃́uwaɛ,
an yã'onɛↄ dɛ lán kusa pↄ́ wa pà gíũgiũↄwaɛ.
Sãdãn mɛ̀ndona mɛ́ dànɛ́.

content: Ma nɛ́, laaika, ńsu yãe kã́fĩuo. Wì taalaↄ bↄ dasidasi a lɛ́ vĩo, mɛ́ kyokɛa zↄ̃ↄ ì mɛ kpasaɛ.
Wà apii mà, a midɛan kɛ:

content.text: Vĩakɛ Luaɛ,
níↄ aà yãdilɛaↄ kũa,
asa gbɛ̃́pii yã́n we.
Lua a yã́kpalɛkɛwanↄ wá yã́ píiwa,
baa asiiyã, a maa ge a vãin nò.
